name: synthetic-poll-failed
description: SYNTHETIC (Ark will not 5xx a poll on request): the submit succeeds and OUR task GET then fails. This must NOT settle. The task is very likely still generating — and BytePlus bills for that generation whether or not we keep asking — so returning the 5xx as data would hand the caller a provider error for a video we already paid for. The poll fn throws instead (design D7), which is retriable, unlike the apify connector's poll.
